title: wss-00: receiveTypingIndicators check cites {{JMAP-CHAT}} without section anchor
description: In draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00.md, the ChatTypingEvent section says the server MUST check receiveTypingIndicators '(defined in {{JMAP-CHAT}})' but gives no section anchor. The main JMAP Chat spec is a long document; a first-time implementor reading the WSS draft needs to know where to find the definition. The reference should cite a specific section or anchor (e.g., the Chat object definition section) so the reader can navigate directly to the normative text.
close_reason: Fixed in review fix wave or recorded as accepted design decision.
